scientific_integrity: Exact all-parameter analytic proof and reproducible finite checks supplied; historical priority provisional in view of earlier hydrologic literature unavailable in complete text.
scientific_limitations: Theorem assumes two impulse-runoff events, identical original first-order reservoir rates, one extra serial linear reservoir on the first tributary, a second runoff volume at least as large as the first, and a storage-free linear confluence. No claims for nonlinear channels, realistic precipitation records, observed flood stages or independent validation.
title: A sharp confluence reversal law for one added detention reservoir
